description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Pahala Thuruvila, Nachchaduwa D/S Division, Anuradhapura District (25/1200075)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels in various districts under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land ownership determinations, cadastral maps, and land title settlement procedures - all falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related administrative processes.
